content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Ashley Roberts (E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: full-time Analyst, recommend write for Payroll.
- Security note: contractor with basic security training, recommend read. Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training.

Access policy:
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.
- Security says contractor with basic training. So maximum is read (no advanced training).

Requested write > maximum read. Grant maximum = read.

So decision: read.
